notes.indice: Index level in points. Sample measured Nov 18, 2026 (a one-off measurement, not a guaranteed latency): S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow Jones with no appreciable delay (seconds) in session; VIX and European indices about 15 min delayed (in the first ~15 min of the European session rows still show the previous close); the Russell 2000 had not updated during the measurement.
notes.futuro: Futures on US indices, in points. Sample measured Nov 18, 2026 (a one-off measurement, not a guaranteed latency): the panel's four futures were about 10 min delayed; the fine-grained measurement, taken only on ES=F (E-mini S&P 500), showed a constant 603-609 s delay across samples.
notes.accion: A selection of IBEX 35 stocks. It is not a volume ranking: without a free source for «most traded» we do not use that label. Sample measured Nov 18, 2026 (a one-off measurement, not a guaranteed latency): the free feed published them about 15 min delayed; in the first ~15 min of the session rows still show the previous close.
notes.materia: Benchmark futures in dollars. Sample measured Nov 18, 2026 (a one-off measurement, not a guaranteed latency): the free feed published them about 10 min delayed.
notes.divisa: Exchange rate between currencies. Sample measured Nov 18, 2026 (a one-off measurement, not a guaranteed latency): no appreciable delay (seconds).

live.lastFailed: · the last update failed; retrying every minute
live.groupEmpty: Data is not available right now. Retrying every minute.
live.footer: Each row shows the time reported by the provider and how old it was when the source was checked (Madrid time); the panel refreshes every minute. This is not official market data and is not meant for trading with guarantees.
live.providerUnavailable: Quote provider unavailable. Retrying every minute.

metaDescription: Indices, futures, IBEX 35 stocks, commodities and currencies with the source-reported time and age of each quote.
pageDescription: Indices, futures, stocks, commodities and currencies, updated every minute.
